signatures.description: Uses Windows utilities for basic Windows functionality

T1053.long: Utilities such as at and schtasks, along with the Windows Task Scheduler, can be used to schedule programs or scripts to be executed at a date and time. A task can also be scheduled on a remote system, provided the proper authentication is met to use RPC and file and printer sharing is turned on. Scheduling a task on a remote system typically required being a member of the Administrators group on the the remote system.

Dear Sir/Madam,


Goodmorning!

We got your contact from our Hong Kong Supplier!

I am Wilbur Benno from Gassner Fertigungssysteme GmbH. We are the trading company in GERMANY with business line of LATHE MACHINES, ELECTRICALS, STEEL and BOLT & NUTS in this regard.

We are bidding for an Overseas Project against which we have requirements Detailed as of the same are attached along with the email - BOQ, Technical Specifications & Mandatory Manufacturer Qualification.

Kindly revert with price asap as per our Order Requirements accordingly .

If you have any question, don't hesitate to contact me.


Best Regards
Wilbur Benno
Procurement Manager
